title: Qualitative research studio

stages.name: frameInquiry
stages.algorithm: Interpret the decision that research should inform and decompose it into answerable questions. Identify plausible rival explanations and what the available corpus cannot establish; avoid converting an exploratory question into a predetermined conclusion.
stages.gate: Every subquestion has observable evidence and an explicit inferential limit.

stages.name: selectSample
stages.algorithm: Define strata from the inquiry, not from convenient examples, then request exact selection within each stratum. Include negative and atypical cases, record nonresponse, and freeze a sampling manifest before coding the main set.
stages.gate: Manifest preserves inclusion probabilities where applicable and explains purposive selection elsewhere.

stages.name: buildCodebook
stages.algorithm: Draft codes from pilot material and research concepts, specifying boundaries through positive and negative examples. Separate descriptive labels from inferred explanations; reconcile overlapping codes without forcing genuinely multidimensional evidence into one category.
stages.gate: Each code is usable on unseen examples and has a discriminating exclusion rule.

stages.name: codeAndReconcile
stages.algorithm: Code bounded passages with their necessary context, then compare independent assessments on a sampled overlap. Investigate disagreements as possible codebook defects; when a definition changes, mark all affected earlier decisions stale before recoding.
stages.gate: Code-version consistency and no silent replacement of disagreement with majority confidence.

stages.name: synthesizeFindings
stages.algorithm: Build findings around supported mechanisms and recurring patterns, actively search for counterexamples, and distinguish an absent observation from evidence of absence. Return unresolved questions and a traceable path from each conclusion to the coded passages.
stages.gate: No causal or population-level claim beyond the study design; counterevidence cannot be omitted.

operational_details: A participant switches language mid-interview: retain original passages alongside reviewed translations.
A code changes after half the corpus is processed: recompute affected records, not only future ones.
A quotation may identify its speaker indirectly: preview re-identification risk before export.
Two researchers disagree productively: preserve minority interpretation in the synthesis packet.
The study stops early: publish achieved coverage and unmet stopping conditions.
representative_episode: An onboarding abandonment study includes satisfied non-completers, dissatisfied completers, and a biased follow-up sample.
independent_truth_basis: Synthetic interviews generated from hidden motives and sampling mechanisms; independent code-boundary and evidence-support assessment.
